invariants.name: active_config_profiles
invariants.population: Runtime configuration records, not strategy profiles
invariants.query:
SELECT count(*) AS n,
                   md5(string_agg(
                       id::text || ':' || md5(jsonb_build_object(
                           'config_type', config_type,
                           'config_json', config_json
                       )::text), ',' ORDER BY id
                   )) AS fingerprint
              FROM config_profiles
             WHERE is_active = true

invariants.name: baseline_score_engine_versions
invariants.query:
SELECT count(*) AS n,
                   md5(string_agg(
                       id::text || ':' || md5(jsonb_build_object(
                           'config_hash', config_hash,
                           'rules', rules,
                           'weights', weights,
                           'thresholds', thresholds,
                           'selected_rule_ids', selected_rule_ids,
                           'status', status
                       )::text), ',' ORDER BY id
                   )) AS fingerprint
              FROM score_engine_versions
             WHERE status = 'BASELINE'

invariants.name: active_strategy_profiles
invariants.population: Active strategy profiles and their economic/runtime configuration
invariants.query:
SELECT count(*) AS n,
                   md5(string_agg(
                       id::text || ':' || md5(jsonb_build_object(
                           'name', name,
                           'config', config,
                           'profile_role', profile_role,
                           'pipeline_order', pipeline_order,
                           'auto_pilot_enabled', auto_pilot_enabled,
                           'auto_pilot_config', auto_pilot_config,
                           'profile_type', profile_type,
                           'profile_version', profile_version,
                           'is_shadow_only', is_shadow_only,
                           'live_trading_enabled', live_trading_enabled
                       )::text), ',' ORDER BY id
                   )) AS fingerprint
              FROM profiles
             WHERE is_active = true

invariants.name: governed_profile_versions
invariants.population: Active CHAMPION and governed SHADOW strategy-profile versions
invariants.predicate: profile_versions WHERE (status = 'CHAMPION' AND is_active = true) OR status = 'SHADOW'
invariants.query:
SELECT count(*) AS n,
                   md5(string_agg(
                       id::text || ':' || md5(jsonb_build_object(
                           'profile_id', profile_id,
                           'version_number', version_number,
                           'config', config,
                           'is_active', is_active,
                           'parent_version_id', parent_version_id,
                           'config_hash', config_hash,
                           'score_engine_version_id', score_engine_version_id,
                           'status', status,
                           'activated_at', activated_at,
                           'deactivated_at', deactivated_at
                       )::text), ',' ORDER BY id
                   )) AS fingerprint
              FROM profile_versions
             WHERE (status = 'CHAMPION' AND is_active = true)
                OR status = 'SHADOW'

invariants.name: terminal_shadow_trades
invariants.population: Trades whose terminal database transition completed before the cutoff; the hash covers identity, entry/barrier and realized-result fields
invariants.query:
SELECT count(*) AS n,
                   md5(string_agg(
                       id::text || ':' || md5(jsonb_build_object(
                           'symbol', symbol,
                           'direction', direction,
                           'source', source,
                           'amount_usdt', amount_usdt,
                           'entry_price', entry_price,
                           'entry_timestamp', entry_timestamp,
                           'tp_price', tp_price,
                           'sl_price', sl_price,
                           'tp_pct', tp_pct,
                           'sl_pct', sl_pct,
                           'timeout_candles', timeout_candles,
                           'exit_price', exit_price,
                           'exit_price_nominal', exit_price_nominal,
                           'exit_price_observed', exit_price_observed,
                           'exit_price_semantics', exit_price_semantics,
                           'exit_timestamp', exit_timestamp,
                           'outcome', outcome,
                           'pnl_pct', pnl_pct,
                           'pnl_usdt', pnl_usdt,
                           'holding_seconds', holding_seconds,
                           'label_resolved_at', label_resolved_at,
                           'completed_at', completed_at,
                           'label_contract_version', label_contract_version,
                           'barrier_contract_version', barrier_contract_version
                       )::text), ',' ORDER BY id
                   )) AS fingerprint
              FROM shadow_trades
             WHERE status = 'COMPLETED'
               AND completed_at < '2026-09-05T11:00:00+00:00'
